title: Claude Code v2.1.79 — Console Auth, Turn Duration, VSCode Session Titles
description: Claude Code v2.1.79 (released March 18, 2026) introduces minor UX and developer experience improvements: (1) --console flag for 'claude auth login' enables Anthropic Console authentication flow as alternative to OAuth (useful for service accounts and headless setups); (2) 'Show turn duration' toggle added to /config menu — displays per-turn timing in status bar; (3) /remote-control command added to VSCode extension for bridging local sessions to claude.ai/code (extends the already-approved remote-control feature); (4) VSCode session tabs now receive AI-generated titles based on first message (reduces 'untitled session' clutter in multi-session VSCode workflows). Bug fixes: claude -p no longer hangs when spawned as subprocess (critical fix for automation scripts), /btw now correctly answers side questions without leaking main agent output, voice mode activates properly on startup.

redundancy_check.notes: Remote-control already approved (73.25/100, 2026-02-28). VSCode improvements extend that approval. Console auth is novel minor utility. Turn duration and AI session titles are built-in UX improvements requiring no integration. The claude -p subprocess hang fix is critical for heartbeat automation scripts.

evaluation.reasoning: Mostly minor improvements and bug fixes. Primary value: (1) claude -p subprocess hang fix is directly relevant to heartbeat automation — verify fix applies to our cron scripts; (2) VSCode /remote-control improvements extend already-approved capability; (3) --console auth could simplify service account setup. No novel capability warranting full integration. Update registry with v2.1.79 version marker and note the subprocess fix. Score reflects limited novel expansion (45/100) pulling the bundle below 70, but still approved as registry update given official release status.
